other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via combined dataset feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating frequency encodings and group-level aggregated statistics (mean, std, median) on a concatenated dataframe of train and test sets leaks test set distributions into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing target value handling
other_failure_modes.description: The pipeline does not check for or remove rows where the target variable is missing before training. If the target contains NaNs, downstream operations like pd.qcut (for stratification) will produce NaNs, causing the K-Fold split and model training to crash.

summary: The agent provides a robust and highly structured regression pipeline featuring correct out-of-fold target encoding, cross-validation, and an optimized ensemble. However, it introduces minor data leakage by computing group aggregations and frequency mappings on the combined train and test data. Critically, it completely fails to ensure the target variable is free of missing values, which could cause the entire stratification and training pipeline to crash if NaNs are present.
